items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Joe Jones took it and maybe, I don't know how, maybe the copyright expired or something.

ctx.x: No, you know why? Because I wasn't given credit for writing it.
You know why? Because of Joe Jones. Yeah. Joe Jones took it and maybe, I don't know how, maybe the copyright expired or something.
No, the copyright never expired. It was never copyrighted. It was never copyrighted.
